title: Travel Memory Coverage by Month
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:photo trip_name=* moments_logged=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(moments_logged) as metric by _time trip_name
| sort 0 _time trip_name
description: Trends monthly logged moments by trip for travel memory capture.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether travel memory capture are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `trip_name` on `memory:photo` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly logged moments.
visualization: Line chart of monthly logged moments by trip.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how logged moments changes month by month for each trip so you can see whether travel memory capture are heading the right way.
